summary: Iteration 60 - Breathwork sound selector feature testing. All features working correctly. Sound selector shows nature sound options (Ocean Waves, Forest Rain, Forest & Birds, Gentle Wind, Crackling Fire, Silence) plus Healing Frequency Tone. Changing sounds, play/pause/reset, and sound toggle all work without breaking the player.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Breathwork sound selector feature is fully functional. The in-player soundscape selector offers: Healing Frequency Tone (session frequency), Ocean Waves, Forest Rain, Forest & Birds, Gentle Wind, Crackling Fire, and Silence. Default sound is auto-selected based on element (Earth=nature, Water=ocean, Fire=fire, Air=wind, Spirit=rain). All player controls (play/pause, reset, sound toggle) work correctly with the new selector.
